history.summary: Large 4BR (1550sqft) at Park Green, a 2005 99yr privatised EC in Sengkang/Buangkok D19, at $1.739M / $1,122 PSF — the lowest PSF in the batch and a liquid sub-$1.8M family ticket. Strong arena record (264-150, Elo 1374) offsets the aging leasehold; no URA project data limits conviction.
history.rating_rationale: $1,122 PSF is genuinely cheap and the $1.74M quantum for a 1550sqft 4BR is liquid for D19 HDB upgraders. Strong Elo 1374 / 264-150 record. But it is a 2005 (21yo) 99yr leasehold with ~78 years left — lease decay starts mattering on a 5-7yr hold and eventual resale — and there is no URA appreciation/median data (regional prior only). Ranggung LRT 590m is the only transit. A solid-value holder, not a growth play.
red_flags: No URA appreciation or median data (regional prior)
catalysts: Deep HDB-upgrader demand for large affordable units

history.summary: Park Green is an EXECUTIVE CONDO (Rivervale Link, Sengkang, 99-yr from 2001, TOP 2004), 3BR 1,195 sqft at $1,350k / $1,130 psf. The eye-catching -24.2% age-adjusted cheapness is largely an EC-vs-private artefact: ECs structurally trade below private condos, so comparing to the private district median overstates the discount. Web comps show Park Green's own recent range at ~$1,122-$1,276 (avg ~$1,135), so this unit is priced at the project's own average — fair, not a bargain.
history.rating_rationale: Once you correct for asset class the value edge mostly disappears: against Park Green's own transactions ($918-$1,249 psf last 12mo, ~$1,135 avg) the $1,130 asking is right at the project mean, not below it — the -24.2% age_adj is inflated by benchmarking a privatised/about-to-privatise EC against private-condo peers. appreciation_pct 4.0% is a regional_baseline on 0 txns (no project-level forward signal), and there is no fresh dated catalyst. The genuine positives are OCR D19 (favoured forward region), Buangkok MRT access, EC build/space value, and a workable family 3BR at a sub-$1.4M quantum, which keep it off Avoid. But with the headline cheapness explained away and no verified sub-market entry, this is a Neutral, not a Buy.
